description: Open-LIFU console secure bootloader: X-CUBE-SBSFU 2.8.0 port for STM32F072 (Console Power PCB). ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 secure boot via CMOX, USB DfuSe update with signature check before slot erase, anti-rollback, RDP level 1 + WRP in the clinical variant. Single-image build: the Secure Engine is linked into the bootloader ELF.

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32F0 (FW_F0)
components.description: STM32Cube package the HAL, CMSIS device files and middleware were generated from. The HAL / CMSIS versions actually in the tree are derived separately.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: HAL v1.7.9, CMSIS Device F0 v2.3.8 and USB Device Library v2.11.6 are the versions STM32CubeF0 v1.12.0 pins (its submodule commits); the .ioc records FW_F0 V1.12.0. Updated 2026-11-16 from V1.11.6.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library (Core + DFU class)
components.description: USB device stack and DfuSe class used by the bootloader's USB DFU update path. Byte-identical to upstream v2.11.6 except Class/DFU/Src/usbd_dfu.c (1-byte mass erase reports errERASE; erase/write failures report errERASE/errWRITE instead of errVENDOR), see Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/LOCAL_CHANGES.md.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Core/ and Class/DFU/ diffed against upstream tag v2.11.6 on 2026-11-16; the version pinned by STM32CubeF0 v1.12.0.

properties.name: openwater:security-note
properties.value: Updated 2026-11-16 from v2.5.3, which passed the host's wLength unbounded into fixed EP0 class buffers (DFU 1024 B transfer buffer); fixed upstream in v2.8.0. Verified on the bench console (old bootloader crashed on a DFU UPLOAD with wLength 4096; the updated one clamps it and stays responsive).

components.name: X-CUBE-SBSFU (Secure Boot and Secure Firmware Update)
components.description: Secure boot framework (SBSFU/App, SBSFU/Target, SECoreBin) ported by Openwater to STM32F072 (Cortex-M0) with cryptography routed to CMOX. Crypto scheme SECBOOT_ECCDSA_WITH_AES128_CBC_SHA256 (the AES key is not used for image confidentiality).

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: SBSFU/, SECoreBin/ derived from STM32CubeExpansion_SBSFU_V2.8.0 (Release_Notes.html v2.8.0 / 05-September-2025); no version string in the ported sources. Heavily modified locally, so not hash-pinned.

properties.name: openwater:support-level
properties.value: ST has no STM32F0 SBSFU reference; this is an Openwater port and is maintained as Openwater code

components.name: STM32 Secure Engine
components.description: Secure Engine core and interface, compiled into the bootloader ELF together with the SECoreBin crypto backend.

components.name: STM32 Cryptographic Library (CMOX, X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB, binary)
components.description: Linked binary libSTM32Cryptographic_CM0_CM0PLUS.a: SHA-256 and ECDSA P-256 signature verification for secure boot (SECoreBin/Src/se_crypto_bootloader.c).

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Middlewares/ST/STM32_Cryptographic/lib/libSTM32Cryptographic_CM0_CM0PLUS.a is byte-identical (SHA-256 above) to the archive in STM32CubeExpansion_Crypto_V5.0.0 (Release_Notes.html V5.0.0); linked by CMakeLists.txt

components.name: micro-ecc (uECC)
components.description: Present in the source tree (Core/Src/uECC.c, *.inc, Core/Inc/uECC*.h, types.h) but in no CMake source list: not compiled into the image. Candidate for removal from the tree.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Core/Src/uECC.c: Copyright 2014, Kenneth MacKay, BSD 2-clause; absent from CMakeLists.txt and cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt

components.name: sha256.c (unattributed SHA-256 implementation)
components.description: Core/Src/sha256.c and Core/Inc/sha256.h: no copyright or licence header, origin not recorded; in no CMake source list, not compiled into the image (secure boot hashes with CMOX). Candidate for removal from the tree.
